project: The King Who Apologized in Stone

policy.render_gate: A photo slot shows a real image only when selected.file exists, selected.licence.status is 'verified' and selected.authenticity.verified is true. Otherwise the slot renders as a placeholder. With --preview-unverified, unverified selections render with an 'UNVERIFIED' watermark and the output is named *_PREVIEW_UNVERIFIED.mp4.

licence_status_values.reported-unverified: A provider or file states a licence, but no person has checked it against the original source page.
licence_status_values.verified: A named person checked the licence on the original source page (verify-licence command).

policy.authenticity: Search results are leads, not facts. An image is treated as showing the intended subject (e.g. the Kalsi rock edict) only after a named person confirms it (verify-subject command).

folders.assets/retrieved/: Images downloaded by retrieve_images.py, each with a .json sidecar holding provider, source and licence metadata.
folders.assets/manual/: Images a person added with `assets.py add-manual` (e.g. downloaded from Wikimedia Commons on another network).
folders.generated/: Pipeline-made assets: voiceover, timeline, map geometry.
folders.placeholders: Not files. Photo-slot placeholders are drawn by page.template.html at render time.

scenes.name: Cold open
scenes.visual: Procedural stone texture; Brahmi title typeset in Noto Sans Brahmi and revealed with chisel sounds; 'Kings brag. / He confessed.'

slots.role: optional background behind the Brahmi text

scenes.name: Setup map
scenes.visual: Map draws in; Mauryan empire fills ochre; Kalinga hatched as independent; Tamil kingdoms labelled never conquered; 'Borders approximate'.

scenes.name: The numbers
scenes.visual: Map zooms to Kalinga, which turns red; counters 100,000 killed / 150,000 deported / + many more dead; source tag Rock Edict XIII.

scenes.name: Remorse on a rock
scenes.visual: Kalsi rock edict photo with slow zoom; RE XIII quote card; 'IN PUBLIC.' and 'ON A ROCK.' stamps.

scenes.name: Not a diary
scenes.visual: 'But here's the thing.' Diary icon crossed out; public notice icon with sound waves, 'Read aloud to crowds'.

scenes.name: Left out in Kalinga
scenes.visual: Dhauli photo with 'Left out in Kalinga' card: Rock Edict XIII isn't carved at Dhauli or Jaugada.

scenes.name: Feeling or performance
scenes.visual: Split card: teal 'Feeling…' over red '…or performance?'.

scenes.name: Evidence both ways
scenes.visual: Pillar photo strip; 'Sincere?' vs 'Strategic?' columns with five cited cards (PE III, RE II x2, PE IV, RE XIII).

scenes.name: Edicts across an empire
scenes.visual: Unzoomed map; 19 edict sites pop in; title 'Empathy as statecraft'.

scenes.name: A way to govern
scenes.visual: Sarnath Lion Capital photo with 'Remorse → a way to govern' card.

scenes.name: Still on the rock (loop)
scenes.visual: Back to the stone and Brahmi shot so the video loops; CTA 'Real or performed? Comment 👇'.

slots.role: optional background behind the Brahmi text
